title: The Warm Stone in the Bed
youtube_title: The Warm Stone in the Bed | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Noemi notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a warm stone slipped into the bed. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Noemi does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
